title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒①

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On one of my days off…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though we don't have training scheduled, Taiki Shuttle drops by my office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yessiree! Actually, my good pals Suzuka and Fukukitaru are competing today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I came to see if ya wanna watch the race with me on TV and cheer 'em on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Got any carrot juice on hand? We can use it to celebrate if either of 'em win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki and I sit down to watch the race together…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka has stolen the lead with her runaway style—the gap continues to widen as she speeds down the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This race has become hers alone! She crosses the finish line, the competition ten lengths behind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was fantastic! Way to go, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't believe she won a graded race by such a huge margin…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's been doin' amazing ever since she came back from Hong Kong! That's her fourth win in a row!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: As her friend, I couldn't be happier! I'm gonna give her a big hug once she gets back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suzuka has taken on numerous challenges in search of her own unique running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she's finally found her answer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka won! This calls for a party!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After such a memorable race, one thing is for sure—we can't afford to take our eyes off of Silence Suzuka.
